title.text: Electric Vehicle Sales Share Over Time

{x: x(unit), y: y(unit), extent_x: domain("x"), extent_y: domain("y")}

tooltip.signal: {"Area": isValid(datum["Area"]) ? datum["Area"] : ""+datum["Area"], "Date": timeFormat(datum["Date"], '%b %Y'), "Electric Vehicle Share (%)": format(datum["Share of registrations (%)"], ",.2f")}

description.signal: "Date: " + (timeFormat(datum["Date"], '%b %d, %Y')) + "; Electric Vehicle Share of Registrations (%): " + (format(datum["Share of registrations (%)"], "")) + "; Region: " + (isValid(datum["Area"]) ? datum["Area"] : ""+datum["Area"]) + "; Area: " + (isValid(datum["Area"]) ? datum["Area"] : ""+datum["Area"]) + "; Electric Vehicle Share (%): " + (format(datum["Share of registrations (%)"], ",.2f"))
